findings.passage: Our decisions, the laws we pass, carry the weight of authority, but only when it’s with the consent of the governed. And that consent is only given when the people have faith that an election was fair and fairly won.
findings.note: Opening of his guest column in the Atlanta Journal-Constitution about the 2021 election bills. He says public faith in election results is the basis for the law's authority. The rest of the page text was garbled in the fetch, so only this clean opening is saved.
